title: Heat Therapy
content: Applying heat to your lower abdomen can help relax muscles and reduce menstrual cramps.

title: Energy Boost
content: During the follicular phase, estrogen rises and brings increased energy and optimism.

title: Sleep Quality
content: Hormonal changes throughout your cycle can affect sleep. Maintain a regular sleep schedule for better rest.

title: Exercise Benefits
content: Regular exercise can help reduce menstrual pain and improve mood throughout your cycle.

title: Hydration Matters
content: Staying well-hydrated helps reduce bloating and can ease period symptoms.

title: Understanding Your Cycle

title: Alleviating PMS Symptoms
content: During the luteal phase, progesterone rises which can cause PMS symptoms. Magnesium and B6 vitamins may help.

title: Peak Fertility
content: Ovulation is when your egg is released and fertility is at its highest. Track symptoms like cervical mucus changes.

title: Iron is Important
content: During menstruation, you lose blood and iron. Eating iron-rich foods helps replenish your stores.
